fusions.name: Ripsaw Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a pull-cord saw through a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Falling Weight
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike that releases a weighted blade, which deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spinning Picket Line
fusions.desc: Stakes a row of spinning blades 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Anything that crosses it is left [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Treadle Whetwheel
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 4% sooner.
